title: DS-160 real-form acceptance: Yakov Kadosh current profile
description: Use Asterisk to perform a safety-gated DS-160 refill acceptance run for Yakov Kadosh. Current date basis: 2026-08-02 America/Vancouver. Recover prior applicant data from authoritative local evidence, preserve source/provenance per field, and require explicit confirmation for time-sensitive facts. Employer candidate from June 2026 immigration evidence: Get In Inc., self-employed; this is NOT confirmed current and must remain blocked until refreshed. Never submit/sign the DS-160, never silently overwrite uncertain values, and require a review diff before applying fills. Definition of done: reproducible local DS-160 fixture or safely captured form structure; exact field mapping; current-employer gate; tests; documented manual review/apply boundary.
notes:
First slice delivered (commit ac55198, worktree rc-ds160-yakov-acceptance-ca69be26): packages/core/src/ds160/ (fieldMap.ts exact DS-160 field->vault mapping for 8 fields across Personal Information / Address and Phone / Present Employment; plan.ts generateDs160FillPlan + isGated; fixtures/ds160-form-structure.json structural-only form contract, NOT a live scrape - see fixtures/README.md provenance note; fixtures/ds160-vault-example.json synthetic fictional-applicant vault, no real PII, dateOfBirth intentionally omitted to exercise unmatched-required-field path; unit tests in __tests__/ds160.test.ts). Confirmation-gate mechanism added to shared types (ConfirmationGate, VaultItem.confirmationGate, FillRecommendation.requiresConfirmation/confirmationReason) and wired into apps/desktop's review-before-apply boundary (confidence.ts getDisposition forces 'blocked' when requiresConfirmation regardless of confidence; FillPlanReviewDialog.tsx both call sites updated; audit notes record the gate reason on apply). Documented in docs/ds160-acceptance.md. Real per-run data (e.g. this issue's employer candidate) is NOT committed anywhere - loaded only into the local vault at runtime, per fixtures/README.md 'No PII' policy; the current-employer/occupation fact referenced in this issue's description remains gated/blocked pending explicit reconfirmation, exactly as required. Follow-ups filed: asterisk-awk (pre-existing tsc build baseline bug, blocks pnpm test + apps/desktop module resolution), asterisk-iaw (apps/desktop lacks test harness), asterisk-0s1 (expand section coverage), asterisk-04p (Rust VaultItem parity). Not pushed/PR'd per explicit instruction. This issue stays open: the broader goal (actual acceptance run against Yakov's real, currently-confirmed data) is still blocked on human reconfirmation of the employer/occupation fact and has not been attempted.

Follow-up fix (commit 7a73878, this session): independent review flagged that findExactVaultItem (packages/core/src/ds160/plan.ts) had a substring/label fallback contradicting the 'exact DS-160 field mapping' contract - a decoy vault item like key 'companyOld' or a label merely containing 'company' could have been silently selected. Removed the fallback (category+key must match exactly now); added 4 regression tests (substring-in-key, substring-in-label, exact-key-wrong-category, exact-match-wins-alongside-decoys). Verified: npx vitest run -> 48/48 pass (44 baseline + 4 new); npx tsc --noEmit shows only the same pre-existing baseline errors (asterisk-awk), zero new errors from either commit.

title: Fix packages/core tsc build (matching.test.ts + performance.ts strict-mode errors)
description: Baseline issue discovered while working asterisk-kkf (DS-160 acceptance slice), not introduced by that work. packages/core's 'tsc' build (tsconfig include=src/**/*, so it typechecks tests too) fails with: (1) src/__tests__/matching.test.ts imports 'type VaultItem, type FieldNode' from '../matching', but matching.ts never re-exports those types (TS2459) - fix by importing from '../types' instead, or re-exporting from matching.ts; (2) two FormSnapshot literals in matching.test.ts have field.type typed as plain 'string' instead of the FieldType union, causing TS2345 - fix with 'as const' or explicit FieldType annotations; (3) src/performance.ts:199-200 'number | undefined' not assignable to 'number' (percentile/duration calc under noUncheckedIndexedAccess); (4) src/performance.ts:309 unused 'metric' param (TS6133); (5) src/performance.ts:323 possibly-undefined array access (TS2532) x2. Because turbo.json's 'test' task depends on 'build', and 'build' runs bare 'tsc' (which typechecks + emits), this failure means 'pnpm test' never reaches any package's vitest run, and no package ever gets a built dist/ - which in turn means apps/desktop cannot resolve '@asterisk/core' via TypeScript (Cannot find module) even though 'npx vitest run' (bypassing turbo) passes fine. Verify with: cd packages/core && npx tsc --noEmit.
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/core && npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; pnpm test from repo root reaches and passes vitest for all packages; apps/desktop can resolve '@asterisk/core' types (no TS2307).
close_reason: Fixed in 98f70ca — all 5 tsc errors resolved (matching.test.ts import fix + FormSnapshot annotations; performance.ts non-null assertions + unused-param rename). Verified: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; npx vitest run 48/48; pnpm test reaches/passes core+extension vitest and desktop build; pnpm typecheck passes for all 4 packages; pnpm build succeeds with dist/ generated. Remaining apps/qa Playwright failure is an unrelated environment gap (no Chromium installed), filed separately as asterisk-crx.

title: apps/qa Playwright e2e tests fail: no Chromium binary installed in sandbox
description: Discovered while verifying asterisk-awk (packages/core tsc baseline fix). 'pnpm test' from repo root: @asterisk/core (48/48) and @asterisk/extension (91/91) vitest suites pass; @asterisk/desktop:build succeeds. @asterisk/qa#test (playwright test, apps/qa/e2e-tests/*.spec.ts) fails all 30 non-skipped specs with 'browserType.launchPersistentContext: Executable doesn't exist at ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium-1200/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/...'. ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright has no chrome-mac-arm64 directory at all - Playwright's browser binaries were never downloaded in this sandbox/worktree. This is an environment/tooling gap, not a code or TypeScript defect - unrelated to asterisk-awk's scope (which is specifically about packages/core's tsc build) and left untouched there.
acceptance_criteria: Either: (a) 'pnpm exec playwright install' (or equivalent) is run/documented as a required setup step for this sandbox and apps/qa's e2e suite passes afterward, or (b) apps/qa/README or root docs note that e2e tests require a one-time 'playwright install' and CI/sandbox provisioning is updated to run it automatically.
close_reason: Fixed in c2b53d6. Chromium was installed globally, exposing 9 real failures behind the missing-binary issue this bead originally tracked. Root cause for most: playwright.config.ts webServer.url only waited for Vite (:1420), not the Rust backend's HTTP bridge (:17373), which starts later on a cold cargo build. Fixed via a new global-setup.ts gate, a second webServer entry for the :8765 static form server, waitForDesktopApp's retry budget bumped 10s->45s, and test.describe.serial() + an explicit form-snapshot POST for llm-matching.spec.ts's stateful phases. Also required a real product fix: apps/extension/src/background.ts GET_DESKTOP_STATUS was returning a cached, up-to-60s-stale isDesktopAvailable instead of a live check, and several extension-popup.spec.ts offline-simulation tests were mocking the wrong scope (popupPage.route() instead of context.route()) and had only ever passed by accident. Verified: npx playwright test x6 consecutive runs, 46 passed/5 skipped/0 failed every time; pnpm test/typecheck/build all pass at repo root; apps/extension unit tests 91/91 unaffected.

title: Add ConfirmationGate parity to Rust VaultItem struct
description: packages/core/src/types.ts gained VaultItem.confirmationGate (ConfirmationGate) and FillRecommendation.requiresConfirmation/confirmationReason as part of asterisk-kkf's DS-160 acceptance slice. crates/vault/src/lib.rs's VaultItem struct was intentionally left untouched in that slice (safe because the DS-160 fill-plan logic is a pure packages/core library, not yet wired to any Tauri command, so the Rust vault backend never sees a VaultItem produced by that code path). Before the confirmation gate can flow through the actual desktop vault backend, add a matching Option<ConfirmationGate> field to the Rust VaultItem struct (crates/vault/src/lib.rs), with #[serde(default)] for backward compatibility, plus a ConfirmationGate struct mirroring the TS shape (reason, evidence_date, status).
acceptance_criteria: crates/vault/src/lib.rs VaultItem has a confirmation_gate: Option<ConfirmationGate> field; cargo test passes; serde round-trips a VaultItem with and without the field.

title: Expand DS-160 field-mapping coverage beyond first slice
description: packages/core/src/ds160/ (asterisk-kkf first slice) covers only Personal Information (surname, given names, DOB), Address and Phone (email, phone, home country), and Present Employment (occupation, employer name) - 8 fields total. The full DS-160 has many more sections (Passport, Travel, Travel Companions, Previous U.S. Travel, U.S. Contact, Family, Security and Background). Expand DS160_FIELD_MAP (packages/core/src/ds160/fieldMap.ts) and the fixture (fixtures/ds160-form-structure.json) to cover more sections, following the same exact-mapping + ConfirmationGate pattern. Keep fixtures PII-free per fixtures/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: DS160_FIELD_MAP covers at least one additional DS-160 section with matching fixture fields and tests.

title: Add vitest+RTL test harness to apps/desktop
description: apps/desktop has no test config (no vitest.config, no __tests__ dirs) - see AGENTS.md session for asterisk-kkf (DS-160 acceptance slice). That slice wired FillRecommendation.requiresConfirmation through apps/desktop/src/components/fillplan/confidence.ts (getDisposition) and FillPlanReviewDialog.tsx (audit notes), but with no way to unit-test it in that app; only the pure packages/core logic (packages/core/src/ds160/) got automated coverage. Add vitest + @testing-library/react to apps/desktop and cover: getDisposition(confidence, requiresConfirmation) forcing 'blocked' regardless of confidence, and FillPlanReviewDialog defaulting gated rows to unchecked.
acceptance_criteria: apps/desktop has a vitest config and at least one passing test exercising getDisposition's requiresConfirmation override.
